name: Bariaur
sourceDistinctions: The Medium playable profile on p. 8 differs from the Exalted Bariaur in Book of Exalted Deeds. No Bariaur correction appears in the November 2004 errata.
Powerful Charge grants one ram during a charge for 2d6 plus 1½ times Strength modifier. The profile grants no standalone ram, rider, or extra attack.
Spell resistance uses class level, and the racial +2 Will bonus is limited to spells and spell-like abilities.
The 2004 profile coexists with the D&D Beyond Drops playable profile and separate Bariaur Wanderer monster.
portraitForm: Mara Sedgehill, an original Bariaur Ranger
